introHtml: Etched decoration gives classic C handle mugs a permanent, sophisticated look that stands up to frequent dishwasher use. Unlike printed designs, etching creates a subtle frosted contrast on the ceramic surface that never fades or peels. Marketing directors and HR leaders choose etched mugs for client appreciation gifts or employee awards because the clean, professional finish works with any brand aesthetic. The durable C handle provides a comfortable grip, and the 11 oz capacity is ideal for coffee or tea. Decorate with your logo for a lasting impression.
